Usage drawn on a creature or armor

The lines of this rune overlap strangely, making it seem larger than it really is. The rune-bearer gains a +2 status bonus to Athletics checks. They can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} creatures up to two sizes larger than themself, or three sizes larger if the rune-bearer is legendary in Athletics.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-runesmith-assistant.pf2e-runesmith-assistant-items.Item.s3cil1tttjpA2N7f]{Effect: Feikris, Rune of Gravity}

Invocation All creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] around the rune-bearer must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:runesmith] save or be pulled 5 feet toward the rune-bearer (or 10 feet on a critical failure).

Level (17th) The status bonus increases to +3.
